description.fun: Minun cares more about its teammates than itself, cheering for them with showers of sparks that grow bigger when its partner is in trouble. Its electric current boosts blood circulation and energises whoever it targets. It hates water, so when it rains it hides under the eaves of houses. Its first big anime role came in episode 312, matching its National Pokédex number.
description.guide: An Electric-type Pokémon marked with blue minus signs, the counterpart of Plusle; Minun leans towards defence where Plusle leans towards attack. It cheers on its allies with electric pom-poms. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A minus-charged cheerleader that sparks harder when friends struggle
